## Pull Request Checklist

Please ensure your pull request meets the following criteria:

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (run `ruff check .`)
- [ ] I have verified the architecture dependency rules (`python -m importlinter`)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes (`pytest tests/`)
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly (`docs/PATCHLOG.md`)
